faqs.question: Do Open University students need to live near a campus?
faqs.answer: Most study remotely. The Belfast office on Victoria Street is a support base — city-centre housing is optional, not required for study.

faqs.question: When should I start looking if I want a home near the Belfast office?
faqs.answer: If you want somewhere near Victoria Street, treat it like any Belfast rental search — popular streets go early, so looking from late autumn through spring for the next year gives more choice.
